scriptLines: query: 'SELECT CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), fecha, 112) AS INT) AS fecha_key, CAST(fecha AS DATE) AS fecha_completa, CAST(YEAR(fecha) AS SMALLINT) AS anio, CAST(DATEPART(QUARTER, fecha) AS TINYINT) AS trimestre, CAST(CONCAT(\'T\', DATEPART(QUARTER, fecha)) AS VARCHAR(10)) AS trimestre_nombre, CAST(MONTH(fecha) AS TINYINT) AS mes, CAST(CASE MONTH(fecha) WHEN 1 THEN \'Enero\' WHEN 2 THEN \'Febrero\' WHEN 3 THEN \'Marzo\' WHEN 4 THEN \'Abril\' WHEN 5 THEN \'Mayo\' WHEN 6 THEN \'Junio\' WHEN 7 THEN \'Julio\' WHEN 8 THEN \'Agosto\' WHEN 9 THEN \'Septiembre\' WHEN 10 THEN \'Octubre\' WHEN 11 THEN \'Noviembre\' WHEN 12 THEN \'Diciembre\' END AS VARCHAR(20)) AS mes_nombre, CAST(CASE MONTH(fecha) WHEN 1 THEN \'Ene\' WHEN 2 THEN \'Feb\' WHEN 3 THEN \'Mar\' WHEN 4 THEN \'Abr\' WHEN 5 THEN \'May\' WHEN 6 THEN \'Jun\' WHEN 7 THEN \'Jul\' WHEN 8 THEN \'Ago\' WHEN 9 THEN \'Sep\' WHEN 10 THEN \'Oct\' WHEN 11 THEN \'Nov\' WHEN 12 THEN \'Dic\' END AS CHAR(3)) AS mes_corto, CAST(DATEPART(ISO_WEEK, fecha) AS TINYINT) AS semana_anio, CAST(DAY(fecha) AS TINYINT) AS dia_mes, CAST(dia_sem_iso AS TINYINT) AS dia_semana, CAST(CASE dia_sem_iso WHEN 1 THEN \'Lunes\' WHEN 2 THEN \'Martes\' WHEN 3 THEN \'Miércoles\' WHEN 4 THEN \'Jueves\' WHEN 5 THEN \'Viernes\' WHEN 6 THEN \'Sábado\' WHEN 7 THEN \'Domingo\' END AS VARCHAR(20)) AS dia_nombre, CAST(CASE WHEN dia_sem_iso IN (6, 7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS es_fin_de_semana FROM (SELECT fecha, ((DATEPART(WEEKDAY, fecha) + @@DATEFIRST - 2) % 7) + 1 AS dia_sem_iso FROM (SELECT admission_date AS fecha FROM silver.admissions WHERE admission_date IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT discharge_date AS fecha FROM silver.admissions WHERE discharge_date IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT payment_date AS fecha FROM silver.billing WHERE payment_date IS NOT NULL) f) fc',
